description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the HomePageDao, which tests methods related to retrieving home page and default module pages based on user roles and priorities within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: HomePageDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for HomePageDao, testing retrieval of homepage and module default page data based on user roles and priorities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case by truncating tables and populating fixtures.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving home pages ordered by priority for a single role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving home pages ordered by priority for multiple roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests the behavior when no home pages match the given role.

methods.name: testGetHomePagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests the behavior when no roles are provided.

methods.name: compareHomePages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual home page results.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderOneRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving module default pages ordered by priority for a single role.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderMultipleRole
methods.description: Tests retrieving module default pages ordered by priority for multiple roles.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrderNoMatches
methods.description: Tests behavior when no module default pages match the criteria.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityNoUserRoles
methods.description: Tests behavior when no roles are provided for module default pages.

methods.name: compareModuleDefaultPages
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual module default page results.
